title: The AWS CLI's own error banner, awsQueryCompatible with the header present
why: The same not-found as cli-banner, from a service that does send x-amzn-query-error — real SQS, and Overcast once #1816 lands. botocore's BaseJSONParser._do_query_compatible_error_parse replaces the __type-derived code with the header's Query code whenever the header is present, and the CLI's banner is a rendering of that same Error.Code, so `aws sqs delete-queue` against real AWS prints `An error occurred (AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue) when calling the DeleteQueue operation`. Measured, not inferred: aws-cli 2.36.18 against a stub answering this body with and without the header prints exactly these two banners. The modeled shape is not on stderr at all here: a modeled error is rendered as the banner and nothing else, so the CLI echoes no JSON body for the shape to be read from. A clause naming only the shape therefore cannot match, which is the mirror of cli-banner's Query-code clause and the reason a generated clause carries both spellings.

wire.stderr: aws sqs delete-queue: exit status 254: An error occurred (AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue) when calling the DeleteQueue operation: The specified queue does not exist.

expect.name: a clause naming the modeled shape and the Query code
a clause naming only the Query code
a clause naming only the modeled shape
a near miss the banner's code ends with
